$comment: Schema for unmount_ext extension actions. Self-contained and closed: re-declares every property action.v1 would otherwise provide and rejects any undeclared field, on itself and on its own payload (cpt-frontx-dod-gts-type-provider-infra-schema-ownership).

type.$comment: Self-reference to this action's schema type ID

target.$comment: Lifecycle actions target domains only — the extension is identified via payload.subject

subject.$comment: Extension ID that this action targets

history.$comment: Optional history intent; the runtime reads it only to choose the acceptance command's verb and never passes it to the router

payload.$comment: Action payload with required extension reference and optional history intent
